skill.displayName: Csdn Article Publish(CSDN博客文章发布) Skills
skill.summary: csdn blog article publish skills,CSDN博客文章生成与发布技能。实现CSDN博客网站的文章的创建、保存草稿、更新和发布。适用场景：(1) 用户请求"帮我写一篇XX文章，保存到CSDN" (2) 用户请求"更新我CSDN上的某篇文章" (3) 用户请求"发布我的CSDN文章" 时调...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CSDN Blog Article Publish Skills.

- Create, update, save drafts, and publish articles on CSDN via Node.js scripts.
- Supports local Markdown file import/export, and automatic file-to-article ID mapping using csdn_article_map.json.
- Provides extensive local pre-checks for configs, title, tags, summary, and required fields to reduce errors.
- Includes detailed usage documentation covering configuration, CLI commands, and troubleshooting.
- Designed to help automate typical CSDN blogging workflows such as "write, update, publish".
